in_sanskrit.name: Gullu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little One
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gullu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gullu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gudh’, which means ‘caldron’ or ‘container’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is often referred to as ‘Gullu’ due to his large belly, representing his ability to hold and fulfill all desires. This name is bestowed upon a child with a loving, caring nature and a strong desire to fulfill the needs of others.
